verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no recipient-facing off-ramp that converts stablecoins into local-fiat bank transfers, and no published list of off-ramp currencies or countries. What it does show runs the wrong way or serves the wrong party. Stripe payouts convert a platform's fiat into USDC sent to recipients' wallets. The onramp is fiat-to-crypto. Merchant stablecoin acceptance settles as fiat in the merchant's own Stripe balance, not into recipients' bank accounts. Community commentary also notes that converting USDC back into fiat is left to the recipient, with restrictions, delays and fees.
